[b]Fixes[/b][/p][p]- Fixed stacking and closing order issues for some UI windows.[/p][p]  - Blessing status window now closes before exiting the inventory.[/p][p]- Fixed missing death effects for some entities.[/p][p]- Fixed leftover lava in Amir's room.[/p][p]- Attempted fix for crashes caused by Laveel.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where swapping two books in the inventory could cause one book’s passive skill to disappear.[/p][p]
[b]Other[/b][/p][p]- If you continue to experience performance issues, please contact us via Discord, Bilibili, or email [url="https://(library.of.meialia@gmail.com)"](library.of.meialia@gmail.com)[/url]. Please include your computer hardware information and game logs if possible: [/p][p]%USERPROFILE%\\AppData\\LocalLow\\Minerva Game Studio\\Library of Meialia\\Player.log[/p]

tags.feature: - Game end screen and settlement information added.
- When your health runs out, two characters will point their fingers and comment at you. Try not to get too annoyed.
- New shop refresh feature (Cham's shop only).
- Added new equipment: Elemental Echo Emitter, Arena Commemorative Coin, Singular Watch, Soul Talisman, Exploding Dust, etc.
- New combat rooms.
- New interactable objects inside rooms.

tags.balance_change: - Introduced Dynamic Damage Reduction:
- All bosses will gain some damage reduction if they take high damage in a short period of time.
- True damage is unaffected by dynamic damage reduction.
- Some special rooms will no longer appear on the first floor.
- "Defense" has been renamed to “Guard” across the game.
- Camera now moves smoothly between rooms.
- Camera now instantly switches to the post-teleport viewpoint.
- Summons (e.g., Rhombear, Crushing Claws) will now follow the player when teleporting.
- The timer for Tranquil Lake is now easier to read.

tags.feature: - Added a warning when loading a save from an incompatible version.

tags.balance_change: - Heart of Earth moved from a passive skill to equipment:
- Passive skills no longer have status information; Heart of Earth will now retain its HP bonus even if unequipped and re-equipped.
- Adjusted some equipment effects.
- Aethium Dialyzer now grants a shield instead of healing.
- Reduced the healing effect of Not-That-Urgent Bandage.
- Light element texts are now more legible.
- On higher difficulties, the base drop rate for Healing Shards is no longer zero, and the drop rate from Blessings is reduced.
- Greatly increased Avgium drop rate on higher difficulties.
- Any mob now has a small chance to drop an elemental orb matching their elements.

tags.feature: - Added room clear rewards — now magic books and equipment can be dropped.
- Removed (Experimental - Melee Combo Bonus: each time a spell is cast, it grants the same damage multiplier and is then cleared.)
- Developer Mode: Can be enabled in settings to access console and other functions.
- (Experimental) Disabled carrying duplicate equipment (gamerule enableEquipmentDuplication).
- (Experimental) Ues legacy map generation parameters (gamerule useLegacyLayout).

tags.bug: - Fixed stacking and closing order issues for some UI windows.
- Blessing status window now closes before exiting the inventory.
- Fixed missing death effects for some entities.
- Fixed leftover lava in Amir's room.
- Attempted fix for crashes caused by Laveel.
- Fixed an issue where swapping two books in the inventory could cause one book’s passive skill to disappear.

tags.bug: - New elite enemy: fixed the issue where [b]Maskito[/b] were missing in some areas.

tags.feature: - New Boss: Laveel (and its potential variants).
- Added new animations/moves to existing bosses.
- All bosses now exhibit different behaviors at different difficulty levels.
- Added several new equipment.
- Added a new Fire passive.
- When you pick up a magic book in the dorm, the other book no longer disappears—instead you can swap between them using your main-hand book. Players can now test both books.
- Clicking certain hyperlinks in [b]**The Great Pictorial Guide of the Grand Library of Meialia**[/b] will jump directly to the corresponding entry.
- Active blessings can be viewed in the inventory.
- Charge skills and Hold skills now only count as cast” when they are fully released.
- Only Difficulty 0 follows a fixed floor order (Ice → Desert → Jungle). On higher difficulties, the three floors’ biomes are randomized without repetition.
- In Key Bindings, you can now assign up to two keys per action.
- Added vine destruction (may fix certain related issues).

tags.bug: - Fixed an issue where melee attacks could hit multiple times if the enemy moved.
- Corrected the damage calculation for the Burst Reaction (Fire + Earth).
- Fixed recursive-damage errors in the Crack Reaction (Wind + Earth).
- Fixed the enemy health bar rotating along with the enemy.
- Fixed a potential lighting-optimization issue.

tags.feature: - Added titles to some rooms so players can recognize special rooms more easily.
- Added display for player healing amount and damage dealt to shields.

tags.balance_change: - Blessings: adjusted blessing effects, their values, and refresh mechanics.
- Modified floor progression and difficulty values.
- Before the first clear, stage order is fixed as Ice → Desert → Jungle; after the first clear, floor order is randomized.
- When Anemos is destroyed, the central crystal now disappears instead of turning gray.
- When entering a level’s exit door, if there are still uncollected items in the room, a single confirmation prompt will appear; interacting with the door again will force entry into the next stage.
- The Amir’s room has been brightened, and The Amir’s hand will no longer push the player.
- Water Pulengs’s summoned projectiles no longer deal damage while they are still near the caster.
- (Experimental) Melee Combo Bonus: each time a spell is cast, it grants the same damage multiplier and is then cleared.

tags.bug: - Ember-In-Peach can now move normally.
- Using the Unbinder to cut the final page (passive skill) no longer displays an incorrect page.
- Fixed the issue where the camera would sway up and down when zoomed out.
- Being knocked back or launched while defending no longer cancels the defense state.
- In The Amir’s room, items will no longer fall into lava and become irretrievable.
- Tooltip pop-ups for passive skills now display correctly.
- Non-elemental damage is now displayed in white.
- Stamina recovery from dive attacks after hitting a target no longer fully restores stamina.

notes.title: Library of Meialia Demo Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193770/e8f6ae92a193647f9b9363c2906125b8d21a25dc.png[/img]

[b]New[/b]
- Unbinder, allow cutting magic books into one book page.
- Book prefixes, prefixes will now add extra effects to the magic books.
- Blesses, now the library will bless you with 30 different bonuses.
- Melee Combat rework
  - When player is on the ground:
    - W + Left Click: Lunge
    - W + Right Click (Defense) + Left Click: Ground Flap
  - When player is in the air:
    - S + Left Click: Stoop, push target downward
    - S + Right Click: Stoop, lift target upward
    - Right Click: Wing attack (default old air melee attack)
    - Left Click: Air claw attack (slightly quicker than ground claw attack)
    - Sprint/Wing attack + Left Click: Roll attack
  - Melee Attacks would deal different damages/ranges in different orders.
- Add a few passive skills and one active skill.
- Add space Pulengs and soul Pulengs.

[b]Changes[/b]
- Skill reworks, most skills would have different behaviors at higher levels.
- Arcane book pages are now valid book pages and can be acquired by cutting arcane books.
  - Arcane book pages can also be placed on their corresponding elements. (i.e., Supernova can be placed on both arcane books and fire books)
- Level/Floor difficulty: changed numerical values of enemies in different difficulties.
  - Now enemies would behave differently in different difficulties.
- Alliance entities would have different colors in their health bar.
- Tsurura Princess, Ember in Peach, and Stone Eye will drop blessings.
- Book drops will now have a better chance of dropping light/dark/soul/space.

[b]Fixed[/b]
- Aethium shard count will now display properly.
- Floor enemies (Jungle/Desert flowers, Sahamusi Spear soldiers) won't jump when trying to trace the player.
- Fixes Ember in Peach does not spawn in the library sometimes.

[b]Other[/b]
- If you continue to experience performance issues, please contact us via Discord, bilibili, or email (library.of.meialia@gmail.com). Please include your computer hardware information and game logs if possible:
%USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\Minerva Game Studio\Library of Meialia\Player.log

[b]Known Issue[/b]
- In-game joystick controls are not yet implemented. Since this is still a prototype, improvements will be made to ensure a better controller experience before early access.

- Dual page skills now require twice as many as Aethium shard to upgrade.
- Unidentified pages are now very cheap so could be purchased for only about 30% of the original price.
[b]Fixed[/b]

- Fixed the issue that items in the inventory will reappear when exit the library level and reload the game.
- Fixed issue with camera movement: now camera movements are smoother than before.
- Fixed the incorrect health value for enemies when using the Student Pass.
- Fixed an issue with level serialization where bosses remaining inside the room even if they are died.
- Fixed an issue with not being able to open inventory or other windows.
- Fixed the invalid cursor state when exited to the main menu.
- Fixed the issue when blood amulet will regenerate health after reloading the level.
- Arcane books will not disappear now when the other book is set to Light, Dark, Space, and Soul.

notes.title: Library of Meialia Demo Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193770/3efda379e69b34351ae362fed4d186ef08117cc1.png[/img]

### New
- Dormitory Added - you can now grab a magic book in your dorm before entering the library.
- Teleportation between the terminal rooms (ie. shops, the aethiumeter room) - Teleport Instantly by clicking the icon of the room on the map.
- Additional rooms with special functions have been introduced.
- New NPC, Ixkik.
- Each page number on the magic book now have a description (page 1 is the left-side skill, page 2 is the right-side skills, page 3 the passive skills)
- Melee attack Combos Added - Consecutive melee hits now deal increased damage.
- Items left in a room will remain there even after reloading the map.
- New enemies in the Jungle: Ember In Peach and Jungle Flower.
- Avgium & Avgamator - now you can refine your abilities with the Avgamator!
- Added vouchers to the library. Different voucher grants different difficulty levels. While not fully implemented, the system is functional.
- Each combat room now features themed Pulengs along with other elemental Pulengs.

### Changes
- No skills will have a "Common" rarity. 
- Some skills now require holding the release button before activation. 
- Dual-page skills now can be released by both key (default Q/E)
- Heat wave now follows your mouse position.
- Minor adjustments to how Sunken effect behave.
- Changed the wind element effect - now enemy will bleed when hit by wind-element damage.
- Changed to the Frozen effect - now water-element damage will always cause a Frozen effect which reduces Entity movement speed and have a chance to fully freeze the entity. 
- Visual improvements for certain wind-element skills.
- Minor adjustments to the melee animation.
- Flying enemies now hover closer to the ground.
- Enemies and Player now will collide instead of overlapping.
- Gates between rooms can now be broken by strong forces, like sprinting into them.
- Damage number will now be shown at a more visible position (for projectiles, it will be where it hit enemy, rather than the center of the enemy)
- Reduce book drops from the Pulengs.
- Elemental interactions now display hints (further mechanic details will be introduced in future updates).

### Fix
- Aethium Shard count display now correctly updates while entering the next level.
- Heart of Earth (Passive Skill) will now double the max health.
- Mama Rhombear's projectile can no longer be destroyed by bare claw.
- Some potential issue causing game save and load problems.

### Other
- Improved Aethiumeter FX.
- Graphic and render Improvement.
- Skill balance.

### Known Issue
- In-game joystick controls are not yet implemented. Since this is still a prototype, improvements will be made to ensure a better controller experience before early access.
